record.paper_title: Some open problems on well-filtered spaces and sober spaces
record.original_question: For a first-countable well-filtered space X, do the upper Vietoris topology and the Scott topology on K(X), the poset of nonempty compact saturated subsets of X ordered by the Smyth preorder, coincide?

evidence.quote: Question 6.13. ([54]) For a first-countable well-filtered space X, does the upper Vietoris topology and the Scott topology on K(X) coincide?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let X be a topological space. A subset A ⊆ X is saturated if A equals the intersection of all open sets containing it (equivalently, A is an upper set in the specialization preorder of X). Let K(X) denote the collection of all nonempty compact saturated subsets of X, ordered by the Smyth preorder: K ≤ L iff L ⊆ K. The space X is called well-filtered if for every filtered family {K_i}_{i∈I} in K(X) and every open set U with ⋂_i K_i ⊆ U, there exists i with K_i ⊆ U. The upper Vietoris topology on K(X) is generated by the basic open sets □U := {K ∈ K(X) : K ⊆ U}, where U ranges over open subsets of X. The Scott topology on K(X) (viewed as a poset under the Smyth preorder, which is a dcpo when X is well-filtered) consists of those upper sets U ⊆ K(X) such that whenever a directed family in K(X) has its supremum in U, some member of the family already lies in U. The space X is first-countable if every point of X has a countable neighborhood base.

Question: For every first-countable well-filtered space X, do the upper Vietoris topology and the Scott topology on K(X) coincide?
artifact.status_search_result: The question has been addressed under additional hypotheses: Xu and Yang (2020) showed that for a first-countable well-filtered space X, the upper Vietoris and Scott topologies on K(X) coincide provided that the set of minimal elements of every Q ∈ K(X) is countable, and they obtained equivalences with local/core compactness when the Smyth power space is first-countable. The general case for arbitrary first-countable well-filtered spaces (without the extra countability assumption on minimal elements) appears not to be fully settled in the literature reviewed.

status_evidence.title: Coincidence of the upper Vietoris topology and the Scott topology (arXiv:2003.06542)
status_evidence.snippet: Coincidence of the upper Vietoris topology and the Scott topology on K(X) is investigated; shown under first-countability plus countability of Min(Q).
status_evidence.claim: Partial results give coincidence under additional hypotheses.

status_evidence.title: First-countable spaces and their Smyth powerdomain — Non-Hausdorff Topology and Domain Theory blog
status_evidence.snippet: The topologies coincide when X is first-countable, well-filtered, and Min(Q) is countable for every Q in Q(X); the unrestricted question is not fully resolved.
status_evidence.claim: The general question remains open while a constrained version is solved.
